description:
Server-side counterpart of the OctoMesh Office Add-In's Excel import.

The add-in posts the selected worksheet range to
"{meshAdapterUrl}/{tenantId}/import/tree" (buildTreeImportUri, used by the
Tree-Path and Tree-Column import panes). That route only exists while a
Pipeline with a FromHttpRequest trigger on /import/tree is deployed on the
tenant's Mesh Adapter - without it every import in Excel fails with 404.

This blueprint seeds exactly that DataFlow and Pipeline, so provisioning a
tenant for the Office Add-In is one InstallBlueprint instead of a manual
ImportRt of a sample file.

The pipeline runs on the Mesh Adapter seeded by System.Communication
(rtId 670000000000000000000002, rtWellKnownName MeshAdapter), which the
Communication Controller applies automatically when Communication is enabled
on the tenant - so there is no adapter entity to seed here.

The route is secured with FromHttpRequest@2 (token required, no role gate) -
the add-in's side of AB#4185 has landed, so it signs the request and maps the
401/403 to its own messages.

Deploy the DataFlow after installing; a seeded Pipeline is not registered on
the adapter until its DataFlow is deployed.
